source.book: GURPS Ultra-Tech Fourth Edition, Version 1.0, 22 May 2007

designs.scope: specified laser constructions only
designs.rules: Blue-green: range x2, RoF/2, two energy shots per firing, not chemical; underwater150/60/15yd cap by clarity. UV: range x3, damage/2, cap500yd/pressure. Rainbow trace/vacuum range/10 loses AD, underwater2yd. X-ray/graser limits per exact source.

designs.scope: laser beam weapons, laser communicators and ladar; source-specific adaptation
designs.rules: HT-10 vision affliction; beam blinding mode uses 1/10 power, hence x10 shots; printed special ranges for ladar.

designs.scope: laser-family beams with pulse-beam hardware; not arbitrary blaster
designs.rules: remove tight-beam; armor divisor reduced one step; double range; pulse-beam costs +100%, switching Ready.

designs.scope: all blasters with purchased Omni hardware, not a default extra attack
designs.rules: Ready switch; HT penalty -1 per normal damage die capped -10; DR/3 protects; unconscious MoF minutes; no HP.

designs.scope: force beams with optional kinetic-stun hardware
designs.rules: fatigue rather than crushing damage; exact extra construction data must be selected before attack.

designs.scope: neural disruptors
designs.rules: agony/ecstasy/neural stun/paralysis/seizure; Ready switching; +50% cost per extra setting; sealed excludes; death setting TL+1.

designs.scope: named resistance weapons, no automatic conversion to HP
designs.rules: Separate target prerequisites, senses, DR/resistance, pressure and cone geometry in descriptions.

designs.scope: eligible beam weapons; not Gatling, not ordinary plasma cartridges
designs.rules: double energy, +1 damage/die or x1.3 damage/radius/HT/Will penalty, Malf14; hot cartridges separate construction.

designs.scope: beam weapons except exempt Gatling designs
designs.rules: RoF x10 accumulation and cooldown; Malf14, or12 during hotshots; not merely changed Damage.

designs.scope: specified TL/family: cell technology, superscience/field jacket/grav focus/FTL/cyborg/biomechanical
designs.rules: Design and environment/power changes; no universal ammunition option or calculated physical cartridge.

designs.scope: all conventional slugthrowers as optional weapon construction
designs.rules: Damage and range x1.5; price x2; A/B/C cell supplies10magazines; physical ammunition unchanged.

designs.scope: conventional caseless alternative construction, Smart Nail Gun
designs.rules: Shots per magazine x1.5; boosted +1/die, range x1.3, propellant1.5; low damage/range half, hearing-3, propellant0.25; 3mag bottles,5s reload.

designs.scope: EM weapons by direct cross-reference
designs.rules: Source allows same velocity settings as liquid propellant; decide dual-resource fractional energy contract before enabling.

designs.scope: four-chamber Gyroc Pistol specifically
designs.rules: Each chamber may contain different15mmrocket; physical magazine currently homogeneous.

designs.scope: explicit projectile weapons and size/TL/sensor limits
designs.rules: GM Artillery lock-on plus separate projectile attack/sensor conditions, no automated flight; guided range is speed/max.

designs.scope: missile propulsion TL11^
designs.rules: no backblast, max x5, cost x2, speed/halfD unchanged.

designs.scope: six disintegrator designs as optional TL12^ conversion construction
designs.rules: AD10 instead cosmic; corrosion plus follow-up burn ex rad sur equal dice; power constraints preserved.

designs.scope: six disintegrator designs as optional TL12^ construction
designs.rules: Only reality-stabilized force screens/DR protect; Temporal Inertia can protect depending on setting.

designs.scope: two projector designs TL11^ optional jammer
designs.rules: Also stops fission reactor/RTG; HT malfunction/restart checks; optional tunable double cost.

designs.scope: all grenade forms and limpet mines
designs.rules: ordinary2s; smartdelay/command/impact/antitamper,3Readyprogramming; no fake damage-only support.

userDecisions.nominalFeed: published N without chamber; fixed per weapon, including alternative physical magazines

userDecisions.burstAndScatter: manual; future grenade automation tracked separately

userDecisions.sourceConflict: UT135 cross-reference vs UT137 own shotgun row remains unresolved
